notes: Primary Results report standardized selection gradients beta=0.91 under ambient herbivory and beta=1.34 under reduced herbivory. Gradients are averaged across the other experimental factors; they are local net-selection states, not two-function geometry.

Among cyanogenic genotypes, primary Results report beta=-0.03 under open pollination and beta=0.19 under supplemental pollination. This source-resolved sign change is net selection by pollination context; it is not promoted to a local pollinator-herbivore geometry.
